title: US Stock Futures Open Higher After Tech Selloff: Markets Wrap - Bloomberg.com
description: US equity-index futures opened higher in early Asian trading as buyers returned following Friday’s sharp selloff sparked by an unwinding of the artificial intelligence trade. Treasury bond futures fell.

title: Delta computer outage disrupts flights at MSP ahead of Thanksgiving - Star Tribune
description: More than 100 flights were delayed at Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport on Sunday as the airline worked to restore an automated system ahead of Thanksgiving.

title: Mike McCarthy doesn’t rule out internal discipline for DK Metcalf - NBC Sports
description: Steelers receiver DK Metcalf had an unfortunate stat line on Sunday.

title: Burnham to tell MPs 'landmark' EU deal could make next decade 'much better' - BBC
description: The prime minister will tell MPs the deal agreed on Friday is a "choice between a broken status quo or change".
